items.summary: Reject the new execution-cockpit proposal this cycle. It is a control-plane product, not a revenue experiment, and delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots with 54 improvements measuring, 21 failed requests, and 7 repairs open. Preserve the concept as deferred backlog only; do not create duplicate queue work. Continue existing 0xroulette.com CTA, allthingsmasonic.com affiliate-path, and amputeenews.com tag-prerequisite work under their current requests.

Revenue experiments remain measurement-first and slot-gated. Existing evidence supports: 0xroulette.com CTA clarity as a reversible outbound-click experiment; allthingsmasonic.com affiliate-path repair with 61 clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; and amputeenews.com affiliate activation only after an owner-supplied registered tag. Do not infer uplift, ROI, or revenue from aggregate data.

GitHub signals remain research-only. microsoft/markitdown passed 8/8 bounded checks under MIT and may support a disposable content-discovery prototype; shadcn-ui/ui passed 3/3 under MIT and may support isolated UX prototyping; mermaid-js/mermaid is MIT but had no native lab checks. No dependency installation, adoption, deployment, or new research request is recommended while capacity and repair backlogs remain constrained.
